what: Addendum to scaled_trike_plan.json (which is left as written): supporting cases added AFTER the first results and after an independent review of the form-factor study (findings PH-1, CTRL-7: drive sets other than D0 never simulated; F3: gains rescaled in every scaled model; MECH-2: the rule has no layout term). Written before any of these cases ran. They are post hoc and supporting: none is a pre-registered size, and no configuration is scored on them.
rules: unchanged: S1 and S2 as quoted in scaled_trike_plan.json, judged on seeds 101-103 with 104-110 as scatter; prediction k x the H0.60 run (as built, D0, similar gains) on the same seed, k = (m / 12.7506 kg) x (H / 0.60 m) with m from the study's mass_model(layout=None, bms=False) for the case's drive set. The trot is the committed walk60 TrotController, Froude-scaled exactly as before; it is NOT retuned for a drive set's mass or leg inertia (so a failure says the rule is unchecked with this controller, not that the configuration cannot walk).
